# Forbidden Terms — GOOD Fixture

This is a **frozen regression fixture** for `forbidden_terms_gate.py`. It must stay
clean while remaining term-adjacent — close enough in subject matter to a real
violation to prove the checker matches specific banned words, not topic proximity.

The story draws on the broader wisdom tradition of Anatolia — the hair-thin crossing
between doubt and devotion — without naming any single order, sect, or scripture.
